description: Byte-parity vectors for the StudioCore-LedgerPort idempotency-key algorithm. StudioCore (TypeScript, formspec-studio) and formspec-server (Rust) must produce byte-identical sha256:<hex> outputs for the same (ledgerScope, branchId, opBatchHash) inputs. Closes the cross-language parity gap pinned in stack rollup thoughts/2026-05-24-adr-0150-followons-and-gating.md §'Owner action items' → 'Known cross-language parity gap (LOW)'.

algorithm.step1_material: Take the three input strings in fixed order: [ledgerScope, branchId, opBatchHash]. For each part, compute its UTF-16 code unit count (JS String.prototype.length / Rust str::encode_utf16().count()) and prefix with '<count>:<part>'. Join the three prefixed parts with '|'.
algorithm.step2_digest: Compute SHA-256 over the UTF-8 byte encoding of the material string. Format as lowercase hexadecimal.
algorithm.step3_format: Return 'sha256:' followed by the 64-character lowercase hex digest.
algorithm.drift_surface: If either implementation drifts to UTF-8 byte length, codepoint count, character count, or any other length measure, the BMP-2byte / CJK-3byte / supplementary-surrogate-pair vectors will diverge. If either drifts to a digest other than SHA-256 of UTF-8 bytes, every non-empty vector diverges. If either drifts to upper-case hex, every vector diverges.

implementations.rust: formspec-server/crates/formspec-server/src/services/action_ledger.rs — pub fn studio_ledger_idempotency_key + pub fn studio_ledger_idempotency_material

vectors.rationale: Baseline ASCII; UTF-16 count == UTF-8 byte count == char count. Drift undetectable from this case alone — included as a positive control.
Latin-1 supplement (é, í). UTF-16 count = char count = 1; UTF-8 byte count = 2. Drift to byte length diverges here.
CJK (中文). UTF-16 count = char count = 2; UTF-8 byte count = 6. Drift to byte length diverges.
Astral plane codepoint (🌟 U+1F31F). UTF-16 count = 2 (surrogate pair); UTF-8 byte count = 4; codepoint count = 1. Drift to byte length OR drift to codepoint count diverges.
All three parts empty. Confirms '0:' material segment is correctly emitted for zero-length inputs and that the algorithm still produces a deterministic digest.
Material delimiters (':' '|') embedded in payload. Confirms length-prefixed encoding survives in-band delimiters without ambiguity.
Newline and tab embedded in payload. Confirms no implicit normalization or whitespace trimming on either side.
Shape matches actual runtime inputs: urn:formspec session id, kebab-case branch id, sha256:<hex> op batch hash. Sanity check for production-like input space.
